FFmpeg licensing notice (Karu)
==============================

Karu may bundle or download a prebuilt `ffmpeg.exe` for desktop capture and
muxing. FFmpeg is a separate project and is NOT owned by Karu.

- Upstream: https://ffmpeg.org/
- Typical prebuilt Windows builds (e.g. BtbN / gyan.dev) are often LGPL or GPL
  depending on the exact configure flags of that build.
- If you redistribute `ffmpeg.exe` with Karu, you MUST also redistribute the
  corresponding FFmpeg license texts that shipped with that build, and comply
  with LGPL/GPL obligations (source offer where required, attribution, etc.).

Karu itself:
- Does NOT ship NVIDIA proprietary drivers or NVENC SDK binaries.
- Uses the system NVIDIA driver / NVENC via FFmpeg's `h264_nvenc` encoder.
- Capture uses Desktop Duplication / ddagrab (no injection into game processes).

Place next to the shipped ffmpeg binary:
  ffmpeg/ffmpeg.exe
  ffmpeg/LICENSE.txt   (this file or the upstream COPYING / LICENSE files)

See also: https://ffmpeg.org/legal.html
